changelog:
Catch-up only offers itself when it will work, and a channel's schedule is easier to read.

WHAT CHANGED

- Watch from beginning appears only on programmes your provider still has in its archive. It used to show on older programmes too and then refuse when you tapped it.
- A programme you start watching from the beginning just before midnight is no longer refused just after it.
- Channels using the "shift" catch-up style no longer open live TV when you ask for a programme from its start. Unless the provider supplies its own catch-up link, they now offer no catch-up at all.
- Each programme in a channel's schedule shows its start and end time and its category. Tap one to see its episode number, category and full description, with Watch from beginning when it is available.
- Tap the now-and-next line on a channel to open that channel's schedule.
- Settings shows how many of each source's live channels have a catch-up archive, and so does the note after a refresh.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including your sources, favourites, settings and guide.

NOT YET

- The guide's storage still grows a little with every refresh, and the Continue Watching row is still to come; both need testing on a phone first.
